scope: Define compatible lifecycle dimensions so canonical entity, contextual alias, implementation container, derived surface, document family, and derived module statuses are not flattened into one contradiction axis.

dimensions.meaning: Lifecycle of the canonical project identity.
Lifecycle of a context-dependent reference to a canonical entity.
Lifecycle of a technical container without identity-renaming authority.
Lifecycle of a visual, experiential, or interaction branch.
Lifecycle of a documentation family or volume series.
Lifecycle of a derived conceptual or technical module.
Temporary fail-closed dimension pending stronger evidence.

compatibility_rule: A lifecycle conflict exists only when two or more occurrences share both normalized_value and lifecycle_dimension but report different lifecycle_status values.

claims.claim: The prior scanner grouped conflicts only by normalized_value.
Mirror Cartographer and MC can normalize to one entity while occupying canonical_entity and contextual_alias dimensions.
Cross-dimension status differences are structural coexistence, not contradiction.
Future alias types should declare lifecycle_dimension explicitly; scanner defaults are compatibility fallbacks.
Any differing lifecycle status for one normalized value is necessarily a contradiction.
Historical labels without adequate decision-log evidence remain unresolved rather than being assigned a stronger lifecycle status.

privacy_boundary.included: Public repository labels, abstract entity roles, lifecycle dimensions, source paths, and deterministic rules.
privacy_boundary.excluded: Raw private conversation, quotations, personal material, health information, relationship material, finances, and identifying narrative context.
